subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw expose context-engine capabilities, status, doctor, and rotate as a core Gateway/plugin control API once the session-targeting and structured-error blockers are fixed?
rationale: This PR creates a new public Gateway surface and optional ContextEngine plugin contract, including an admin rotate operation, so code correctness alone cannot decide the permanent API boundary.

options.title: Approve after blockers fixed
options.body: Keep the core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, structured capability errors, focused regression tests, and maintainer-reviewed docs/scope semantics before merge.

options.title: Ship a narrower read-only surface
options.body: Defer rotate and land only capabilities/status/doctor if maintainers want health inspection before admin maintenance operations.

options.title: Defer to plugins
options.body: Pause or close this core PR if context-engine control should remain plugin/private until a broader Gateway control contract exists.

recommendation.title: Approve after blockers fixed
recommendation.body: Keep the core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, structured capability errors, focused regression tests, and maintainer-reviewed docs/scope semantics before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The hardest product/API choice is the ContextEngine hook contract, and recent context-engine history points to jalehman as the strongest adjacent owner.
